product_risk_or_requirement: The tutor must preserve independent learning rather than optimize only assisted task completion.
current_state: The product scope requires attempt-first and hint-based tutoring, but there is not yet pilot evidence that unaided mastery is non-inferior or improved and that direct-answer behavior stays below threshold.
product_requirement: Before student launch, the tutoring policy must enforce progressive hints after a learner attempt, block full solutions for active practice or assessment contexts, and measure unassisted mastery separately from assisted success.
acceptance_criteria: Given a held-out set of instructor-authored practice tasks and an unaided checkpoint When the release candidate is evaluated Then the tutor never provides prohibited full solutions, the direct-answer rate is at or below 5%, and unassisted mastery is no more than 2 percentage points below the agreed baseline before pilot approval.
evidence_needed: Policy test results, sampled transcripts, direct-answer-rate report, unaided mastery baseline and checkpoint comparison, and reviewer sign-off.

product_risk_or_requirement: Generated diagnosis and feedback need evidence of factual and pedagogical quality before students rely on them.
current_state: Retrieval grounding and escalation are designed, but no independent held-out audit has yet demonstrated acceptable factual-error and misleading-hint rates for this course corpus.
product_requirement: The release candidate must ground factual tutoring claims in instructor-approved sources, expose citations to the user and reviewer, escalate unresolved conflicts or low-confidence cases, and pass an independent stratified quality audit.
acceptance_criteria: Given a stratified held-out set covering common topics, multi-error attempts, adversarial requests, and known misconceptions When an independent reviewer audits the release candidate Then every response is traceable to an approved source or explicit escalation, the combined bad-hint rate is at or below 5%, and no critical unsafe-output event occurs.
owner: Responsible AI and Academic Integrity Reviewer
evidence_needed: Held-out evaluation set, source-provenance logs, reviewer labels, error-rate report by topic and subgroup, escalation test evidence, and signed approval.

product_risk_or_requirement: The exact Vietnam AI risk classification and regulated roles must be confirmed for the final intended-purpose statement and deployment boundary.
current_state: The product is intentionally small-scale, uses controlled course material, and excludes official grading, ranking, and surveillance, but no signed legal memo yet maps those facts to Law 134/2025/QH15, Decree 142/2026/NĐ-CP, and Decision 33/2026/QĐ-TTg.
product_requirement: Block the Vietnam student pilot until legal review documents the system inventory, intended purpose, provider and deployer roles, applicable risk classification, required notices, records, human-control duties, and conditions that would trigger reclassification.
acceptance_criteria: Given the frozen Vietnam pilot scope and system boundary When the launch review is requested Then a signed legal classification memo cites the current law, decree, and high-risk list, names provider and deployer responsibilities, confirms required controls, and records the exact feature or scale changes that require re-review.
evidence_needed: Signed legal classification memo, AI system inventory entry, role allocation, launch obligations checklist, and reclassification triggers.

product_risk_or_requirement: EU launch needs a documented Annex III applicability assessment and Article 50 transparency implementation for direct student interaction.
current_state: The scoped tutor excludes admission, official learning-outcome evaluation, education-level assignment, and exam monitoring, but EU provider/deployer roles and transparency behavior are not yet independently approved.
product_requirement: Keep EU access disabled until the product has a documented AI Act classification, first-interaction AI disclosure, required generative-content marking behavior where applicable, provider/deployer role analysis, and a change-control rule that reopens high-risk assessment when intended purpose changes.
acceptance_criteria: Given an EU release candidate When a student starts the first direct AI interaction and the release board reviews legal evidence Then the interface clearly discloses the AI interaction, the Annex III education-use assessment is documented, applicable Article 50 controls are acceptance-tested, and counsel signs the provider/deployer and effective-date analysis.
evidence_needed: EU classification memo, Article 50 disclosure screenshots or test evidence, marking assessment, provider/deployer role analysis, and legal approval record.

product_risk_or_requirement: Student prompts and tutoring logs require minimization, retention, access, and deletion controls because users may enter personal information even when the product does not request it.
current_state: The data schema is limited to course interactions and pseudonymous telemetry, but retention period, access roles, deletion workflow, redaction behavior, and incident evidence handling have not yet been acceptance-tested.
product_requirement: Collect only data needed for tutoring and safety review, warn users not to submit sensitive personal data, redact obvious unnecessary identifiers before analytics where feasible, restrict staff access, define a 30-day default raw-log retention for the pilot unless incident hold is justified, and provide a documented deletion path.
acceptance_criteria: Given a normal tutoring session and a deletion request When data handling is tested Then no unnecessary identity field is required, raw logs age out under the documented retention rule, only authorized reviewers can access safety samples, the deletion request is completed and evidenced, and incident holds record purpose, owner, and expiry.
evidence_needed: Data-flow diagram, field inventory, access-control test, retention-job evidence, deletion test, user notice, redaction test samples, and incident-hold procedure.
